about_the_game:
Nahu Pyrope brings you Random Access Mayhem's soundtrack, it mixes distorted electric guitars with synthesizers, a lovely combination where it not for the synthesizers also being heavily distorted, resulting in a harsh sound that is sure to scratch your brain in the best of ways.

This album has all the songs you need to start ramming out in the gym or while blasting some homework.

With a total of 29 tracks with varying styles and instrumentation at least one is sure to catch your ear!

Start Camping in Armageddon or Hitchhiking through the Apocalypse with this album today!
